data.cultural_impact: The name Shuqur holds great significance in Islamic culture, as it encourages and celebrates the quality of gratitude. Gratitude is a fundamental virtue in Islam, emphasized in numerous verses of the Quran and Hadiths. The Islamic Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said: "A thankful heart expands the blessings." (Tirmidhi). The name serves as a constant reminder to be thankful for the blessings in one's life and to acknowledge the source of those blessings, which is Allah (God) in Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shuqur holds immense spiritual significance, as it encourages an individual to develop a deep sense of gratitude towards Allah (God) and to acknowledge His blessings. Gratitude is a way to foster a strong connection with Allah (God) and to remember Him in all aspects of life. Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said: "A servant continues to collect the reward of glad tidings or the reward of his blessings until such time as he is brought close (to Allah) [at death]." (Tirmidhi). The name Shuqur is a constant reminder to be mindful of the blessings and to express gratitude towards Allah (God) in every moment of life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah The name Shuqur carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his generosity and kindness. He was one of the Ansar (Helpers) of Medina and was given the name Shuqr (The Generous) because of his abundant hospitality and readiness to welcome and support the Muslim immigrants from Mecca.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi's Al-Mawāqīʿ al-Ẓabīrīyah fī Aḥkām al-Masajid al-Sharīfah The name Shuqur carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Name of a muezzin (person who calls people to prayer) in Cairo who was renowned for his melodious voice and beautiful recitation of the Adhan. He was also known as Shuqr (The Handsome) due to his good looks and charming demeanor.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shuqur has gained modern relevance in various contexts within the Islamic community and beyond. On Instagram, accounts dedicated to Islamic art and calligraphy often use the name Shuqur as a hashtag, showcasing beautiful designs and intricate patterns inspired by Islamic culture. On Pinterest, users save pictures of Middle Eastern dishes and call them by this name, reflecting the rich culinary heritage of Islamic countries. Lastly, on YouTube, Sufi poets and musicians perform and share their works under the name Shuqur, paying homage to the mystical tradition of Sufism and its spiritual meaning.
